stock: Unmodified rsmine.mi_estimator.VBMI_bounds.infonce_lower_bound / TFP 0.25.0, TensorFlow 2.18.1, float32; diagonal positives; test eager AND tf.function CPU. GradientTape on negative bound with a free residual score parameter, initialized at zero, and actual legacy tf.keras Adam(0.009), one fresh step per fixture. Compare actual gradient, post-update parameter and all Adam slot values against the same optimizer on analytic float64 gradients cast to float32. This is an arithmetic probe, not model training; finite score gradients do not prove finite encoder/critic gradients at unknown historical states.
reference: Exactly the same input float32 logits cast to float64, row max subtracted first. Log(48) + mean(diagonal shifted scores minus row logsumexp of shifted scores). Analytic negative-bound score gradient (softmax minus identity)/48. All nats, natural log. Check deterministic matrix invariance only for offsets that preserve pairwise differences exactly in float32; separate any input quantization from loss arithmetic.
fixtures: N=48. Zero logits (bound zero). Independent paired 8-component Rademacher embeddings, dot product / 4, NumPy default_rng(20261126); 32 independent matrices, and column cycle derangement of each, without offsets, to measure null mean and paired-shuffle difference (not an exact zero target for a random nonconstant critic). Signal = +16 on the diagonal, zero elsewhere; use same fixed nonidentity cyclic shuffle. For each canonical fixture (zero, first independent pair, its shuffle, signal and its shuffle), add zero, constant and alternating row offsets +/-2^k (all-positive for constant), k=12,18,20,22,24. Offset sweeps keep same-logit references even if float32 rounds off input differences. The fixed signal and its shuffle are exactly representable over this entire sweep; compare reference there against analytic log(48) - log1p(47 exp(-16)) and minus 16, respectively.
pass_rule: Reference finite and <= ln(48)+1e-12, zero/analytic controls and unchanged-differences shift invariance within 1e-12 nats. Each stock eager/graph result finite, <= ln(48)+1e-5 and within 1e-4 nats of same-logit reference. Stock gradients finite and elementwise max absolute error <= 1e-7, updated residual and Adam slots finite and match reference one-step values to 1e-6 absolute. All required. Independents/shuffles: report distribution, not a data-chosen significance threshold. Publish every fixture, including failures. Historic exact cause / optimizer safety unverified absent failing score matrices and model+optimizer states. If stock gate fails OR prior failure unresolved: NO-GO for a new stock comparison regardless of physical transfer. A reporting-only replacement is not a reviewed training fix.
